name: [💩] Poop and Grow a Brainrot!
desc:
💩 Welcome to Poop & Grow a Brainrot!

How to Play:
🧠 Poop to spawn your first Brainrot!
💸 Brainrots give you money every second  - even when you’re offline!
⬆️ Upgrade luck and strength to poop even faster!
🍎 Feed fruits to grow your Brainrot bigger and stronger!

👍 Like the game and join the group for rewards!
